title: Antalia-2 Mini: A 7.6-million-parameter Turkish text-to-speech model trained entirely on synthetic speech
abstract: arXiv:2611.13811v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Antalia-2 Mini is a single-voice Turkish text-to-speech model with 7,620,931 parameters. It reads characters and produces 48 kHz audio at 41 times real time on an Apple M5 laptop CPU (2 threads). Its training audio came only from VoxCPM2 (the teacher), about 300 times larger, cloning one synthetic clip; automatic checks kept about 1,790 h. Fine-tuning the vocoder on the acoustic model's own mel spectrograms cut the word error rate (WER) of Whisper's transcripts from a mean of 3.89% to 1.75% at adjacent pre-release checkpoints. The teacher corrupts the start of a clip when the first word begins with \"o, the student learned this, and a spoken prefix we cut from the output hides it. On the 495-sentence Freya-TR-Eval benchmark, where we tuned settings, version 1.0.1 has WER 1.09% and character error rate 0.22% on our public harness. A paired bootstrap cannot distinguish these from EMA Lightning, an 8.6M Turkish model, which scores higher on

translated_title: Antalia-2 Mini：一个完全基于合成语音训练的760万参数土耳其语文本转语音模型
translated_abstract: Antalia-2 Mini 是一个单音色土耳其语文本转语音模型，拥有7,620,931个参数。它能以每秒41倍实时速度在Apple M5笔记本电脑CPU（2线程）上读取字符并生成48 kHz音频。其训练音频仅来自VoxCPM2（教师模型），后者规模约大300倍，通过克隆一段合成音频片段；自动检查保留了约1,790小时的音频。在声学模型自身的梅尔频谱图上对声码器进行微调，使Whisper转录文本的词错误率（WER）从相邻的预发布检查点的平均值3.89%降至1.75%。当片段首词以"o开头时，教师模型会损坏片段的开头，学生模型学会了这一点，而我们通过从输出中剪除一个语音前缀来隐藏这一问题。在495句话的Freya-TR-Eval基准测试（我们调整设置所用的基准）上，1.0.1版本在我们的公开测试框架中达到1.09%的词错误率和0.22%的字符错误率。配对自助法检验无法将其结果与8.6M参数的土耳其语模型EMA Lightning区分开来，后者在其中得分更高。
tldr: Antalia-2 Mini是一个仅用合成语音训练、仅760万参数的超轻量土耳其语TTS模型，可在笔记本CPU上以41倍实时速度生成高质量语音，WER低至1.09%。
en_tdlr: Antalia-2 Mini is an ultra-lightweight 7.6M-parameter Turkish TTS model trained entirely on synthetic speech, generating high-quality audio at 41x real-time on a laptop CPU with a WER as low as 1.09%.
